item.description: Imagine if you lived an average American life (77 years or 28,207 days) and you only had to be good 1% of the time to make it to heaven. By my math, 1% would be .77 years or 282 days. Think you could do it? What if God forgave you for 99.9% of your sins […]

item.title: Unwind or rewind
